description: The plot illustrates the training loss over steps for six different model configurations—ChemBART Small 20M, ChemBART Medium 20M, ChemBERTa Small 20M, ChemBERTa Medium 20M, ChemLLaMA Small 20M, and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M—all trained on a 20M data size. The x-axis, labeled “Step,” spans from 0K to 440K, with major tick marks at 0K, 20K, 40K, 60K, 80K, 420K, 430K, and 440K, indicating a non-uniform scale that zooms in on the final 20K steps (from 420K to 440K) in an inset panel. The y-axis, labeled “Train Loss,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.85, with major gridlines at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.75, and 0.85. All six lines begin near 0.85 at 0K steps and exhibit a steep decline in loss within the first 20K steps, after which the rate of decline slows. By 80K steps, all models have reached a loss below 0.2. In the main plot, the lines remain close together with minor fluctuations, while the inset panel (420K–440K) shows that all models have converged to a stable loss near 0.05–0.07, with ChemLLaMA Medium 20M (brown) and ChemLLaMA Small 20M (purple) appearing slightly lower than the others in the final steps. The lines are solid with no markers, and each is color-coded as indicated in the legend.
